runs.prompt: Change the STUSB4500QTR C2678061 NVM policy to request 15 V and prove the UMW AO3401A C347476 load switch remains safely off through dead-battery, reset, attach, hard reset, fault, and disconnect.

conditions: mirror-only STUSB trust; NVM/readback/as-built state absent
ideal VBEN-low divider gives VGS -6 V at 15 V, -8 V at 20 V, -12.96 V at conditioned 32.4 V TVS table point
nominal gate tau approximately 6 ms excluding device/parasitic/waveform effects
response.refusal: Safety proof cannot be established without as-built NVM readback, dynamic gate, parasitic and waveform evidence, reset and fault sequencing, and bench or simulation evidence; no design change is authorized.

response.refusal: No substitution or change is authorized until primary minimum-off-time and inductor evidence and installed effective capacitance close.

runs.prompt: Evaluate Dailywell 1MS1T1B1M1QES-5 C496154 Board L power toggle, common 2 and the isolated live OFF throw; prove both converters unpowered OFF with safe capacitor inrush/contact life and assembled fit.

conditions: SW2 common 2 receives V15_FUSED and joins pin 1 to switched V15 in ON. In OFF, common 2 joins pin 3, which has no PCB net but is fused-feed live. Both converters lose normal supply in OFF; Board P remains powered. Verify modified plated-slot and enclosure fit, front lug clearance, capacitor inrush, bounce, shutdown decay, restart and low-current contact reliability, with SWD/UART disconnected for the OFF test. Exact drawing is manufacturer-mirror evidence, not closed manufacturer-primary trust.
response.refusal: The design graph opens the normal V15 supply in OFF, but common 2 energizes isolated pad 3 and Board P remains powered. Stored charge and ATT/PDOK/SWD/UART back-power are untested. The 5 A at 28 VDC rating from an exact manufacturer mirror does not establish capacitive endurance or manufacturer-primary trust. Modified-slot and front-lug/enclosure fit are calculated or rendered design expectations, not physically validated assembly. Therefore proof of unpowered converters, safe inrush/contact life and assembled fit is refused pending bench validation.
